findings.current: Living long and thin is my life’s philosophy. That’s why I even shit thin and long on purpose!
findings.defect: The literal phrase “living long and thin” is not meaningful English and obscures the risk-averse life philosophy that sets up the crude wordplay.
findings.rationale: 가늘고 길게 살다 means living cautiously and inconspicuously for a long time; the following sentence deliberately reuses 가늘고 길게 in its literal physical sense for the joke.
findings.replacement: My philosophy is to live a long, low-profile life. That’s why I even make my dumps long and skinny on purpose!

summary: The chapter is faithful overall, with one minor loss in joke logic.
